profile.headline: Software Engineer at Veterans United
profile.summary:
I'm a multifaceted individual with a passion for both the digital realm and the equestrian world. 
Beyond my role as a proficient software engineer, where I specialize in C#, .NET, and Angular programming, I lead a dynamic life filled with diverse interests. When I'm not immersed in coding or designing, you'll find me indulging in my passion for equestrian pursuits, losing myself in captivating novels, creating art, or embarking on virtual adventures through the world of video games.  Behind the scenes I live a fulfilling life with my husband in our cozy Columbia home, accompanied by our two beloved cats, Nora and Anya Amberpatch. My journey is a harmonious blend of technology, creativity, and the cherished moments that make life extraordinary. This diverse tapestry of interests not only enriches my days but also fuels my love of learning, allowing me to continuously explore and excel in multiple domains.

positions.title: Assistant Trainer/Web Designer
positions.description:
Assistant Trainer Duties:
- Work training horses
- Teach lessons in private lessons to groups up to 6 riders, age ranges from 4 to 84, and a variety of disciplines and skill levels
- Coach and run day camps periodically as available and needed
- Coach students at local horse shows as needed

Web Designer Duties:
- Remodeled the CEC website to it's current design 
- Maintain the dynamic content. Dynamic content includes: "Words from Kris" status banner, directory of horses, show schedule, camp dates, and show results
- Manage photo archive
- Routinely evaluate website to ensure proper function and continued flexibility to meet the client's growing business needs

Barn Manager Duties (June 2017-Feb 2019):
- Hire, train, and schedule stablehands. Approximately 15 regular scheduled part time employees. 
- Monitor grain, hay, and shavings supply. Re-order and pick up as needed. 
- Coordinate with outside vendors including veterinarian, farrier, chiropractor, and suppliers. 
- Communicate care instructions and observations as needed on approximately 50 horses, ensuring information passes accurately and efficiently between trainers, owners, and stablehands. 

Stablehand Duties:
- Feed, hay, and water approximately 45 horses
- Bring horses at pasture in and turn out horses in stalls
- Give medications and medical treatment as needed

positions.title: Owner/Graphic Designer
positions.description: Responsibilities include: graphic design, client relations, communications, marketing, business operations, and equipment management.

positions.title: Office Assistant/Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Office Assistant Duties:
- Function as a receptionist for the marketing department: greet door traffic, sort mail, answer main phone line, screen Marketing Director's calls, monitor and order office supplies
- Manage sponsorship requests
- File co-op funding claims with national brand for 5 stores
- Serve as point of contact dealership-wide for marketing vendors
- Process invoices for both Joe Machens Dealerships and MAGMA (marketing department)
- Create itemized log and organize receipts for marketing credit cards
- Communicate with local media representatives to supply stamped scripts for co-op, obtain proper co-op documentation, procure end of month numbers for the stores, ensure payments from all stores are received in a timely manner and applied to appropriate accounts
- Maintain "Marketing Expense Sheets" for 6 stores to accurately project monthly expenses and compare how net spend matches what was budgeted

Graphic Design Duties:
- Design and order business cards for all customer-facing employees at Joe Machens Ford stores
- Work with design team to create monthly incentive-based digital advertising for 6 stores
- Design direct mail creative as assigned
- Create social media post content and snapchat filters as needed
- Assist design team as requested

positions.title: Office Support Assistant IV - Physics and Astronomy Department
positions.description:
-Manage the purchasing card system, approximately 30 cards/users per month.
-Process payment requests and create all requisitions/sole source purchases for the department.
-Maintain accuracy of master payroll database
-File expense reports and make travel arrangements as requested.
-Serve as departmental receptionist and assistant building coordinator.

positions.title: Adoption Counselor
positions.description: Communicate with potential adopters via phone, email, and in person. Assist with the creation of promotional materials to describe animals up for adoption. Assist with cleaning of kennels and care of animals.

positions.title: Graphic Designer/NIE Coordinator
positions.description: Designed all circulation promotion and marketing materials. Coordinated the production process of materials. Responsible for coordinating and overseeing all Newspaper In Education programs and events. Assisted in the planning and implementation of online and print promotions. Organized the quarterly block sale to raise funds for the NIE program.

positions.title: Marketing and Design Coordinator
positions.description:
Designed ads on a schedule for seven publications including the Columbia Daily Tribune and The Columbia Missourian. 
Regulated the production of thirty-second TV spots with the local NBC affiliate KOMU-TV8, about twenty-eight spots per year.
Corresponded with the Sales team to ensure corporate sponsors' promotional needs are met. 
Produced creative for all Concert Series productions (about thirty shows per season) including web ads, program notes, meet and greet posters, and sandwich board posters. 
Designed promotional material for new season announcement: annual magazine, brochure, poster, postcard, plastic concessions cup.
Established the design campaign for each new season. The 2014-2015 season included the creation and launch of a new tagline for the University Concert Series, "Good People, Great Performances."
Worked with Event Coordinator to plan and execute annual fundraising event, Premiere, the announcement of the new season. Design work for event included digital and printed invitations, approximately thirty-five coordinating posters to announce show lineup, signage to promote corporate sponsors, branding decor such as customized coasters and water bottle labels.
Operated the University Concert Series website.
Guided the education of a work-study student in real-world applications of design, approximately six hours a week.

positions.title: Interim Membership Coordinator
positions.description: Orchestrated two pledge drives: October 28-November 2, 2013 and December 4-5, 2013. Preparation for pledge drive includes updating premium inventory in database, providing description of premiums for internal and external use, setting up both volunteer and web donation pledge websites, creating digital systems for on air announcement of cases for support, monitoring challenge donations made my major donors, and the printing of gift certificates to be used as premiums. Produced donor mailings to both regular membership and major giving donor lists. Executed the procurement and mailing of all premiums purchased during the drive. Trained incoming Membership Coordinator in the use of Allegiance, the donor database software, and how to run the membership office.

positions.title: Office Support Assistant
positions.description:
Membership:  Dealt with donor database. Prepared checklist and checks for Cash Received Reports. Entered payroll deduction and EFT gifts into Allegiance (specialized public radio membership software). Edited and approved all pledges from pledge drives for database continuity. Organized pre-drive premium setup and premium fulfillment following pledge drives. Managed mailing of “thank you” letters, renewal letters, reminder and credit card error letters. Helped maintain database accuracy and a quality prospect list. Assisted Membership Coordinator with answering basic questions and updating donor account information.
House Manager :  Made arrangements for artists such as catering, instrument or other items requested. Coordinated arrangements with Jesse Auditorium staff. Assisted with backstage duties if needed night of performance.
Front Office: Answered phones and took messages, picked up and delivered mail, organized and ordered office supplies, filed documents and documented meeting minutes. Assisted with Business Office by processing vouchers for accounts payable, reconciling accounts by utilizing spreadsheets and making checklists. Proofread and edited weekly e-newsletter. Produced email press releases, about ten a year.

positions.title: Assistant Editor and Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Edited articles for business newsletter, improving clarity and grammar while maintaining personable, professional tone.
Formatted newspaper ads, cultivating balance, visual interest, and clear communication.
Designed business logo and updated company business card, catering both to functionality and tastes of owner.
Developed informational brochure and advertising banner

positions.title: Bank Response Center Representative
positions.description:
Answered phones in call center environment, using phone etiquette and communication skills to provide customers with quality service
Utilized procedural Bank Knowledge System to take appropriate actions in maintaining customer accounts and bank security
Submitted updates to a procedural maintenance team notifying of broken links, typographical/grammatical errors, and unclear or incorrect information
Assisted with training new representatives, serving as example for listening purposes and answering questions in small group settings

positions.description: Same job duties as Customer Service Representative at State Farm Bank. See above listing

Analyzed and critiqued submissions, participating in selection process and providing constructive feedback for students.
Designed posters promoting upcoming events.

volunteerExperiences.description: I take animals (cats specifically) that are either too sick, too shy, or too small into my home to give them private care until they are ready for adoption. CMHS provides all the necessary supplies, I just donate my time, effort, and patience. Outside of routine care, I do also have to administer medicines to the foster animals. The animals stay with me for an average of two to three weeks before they go back to the shelter. They can be anywhere from three months to twenty years in age. It's very difficult not to just keep them all, but I find it to be a very rewarding experience. Fosters help offset the times when there are more animals coming in than there is room in the shelter to keep them.
